privacidad.s1_x: We only collect the data you provide directly when placing an order via WhatsApp: name, phone number and, where applicable, delivery address. We do not use hidden forms or collect browsing data for advertising purposes.
privacidad.s2_x: Your data is used exclusively to process your order, coordinate payment and delivery, and provide after-sales support. We never sell or share your information with third parties for commercial purposes.
privacidad.s3_x: The shopping cart and your language and currency preferences are stored only in your own browser (localStorage). Noptabu does not store this information on its own servers.
privacidad.s4_x: Orders are handled through WhatsApp, so the processing of data sent through that channel is also governed by the privacy policies of Meta Platforms, Inc.
privacidad.s5_x: Our products are intended exclusively for people over 18 years of age. We do not knowingly collect information from minors. If we detect data from a minor, we will delete it immediately.
privacidad.s6_x: You may request at any time the review, correction or deletion of your data by writing to the contact email shown on the contact page.
privacidad.s7_x: Any change to these policies will be published on this same page with its corresponding update date.

politicas.subtitulo: NOPTABÚ's privacy, warranty and sales policies.

garantia.s1_x: At NOPTABÚ, hygiene and quality are non-negotiable. Every item is individually inspected and tested before being packed and shipped: we check its operation, physical condition and that its packaging is sealed. Our commitment is that you receive exactly what you ordered, in perfect condition.
garantia.s2_x: Due to the intimate and hygienic nature of the products we sell and distribute, and for the wellbeing of all our customers, we do not offer exchanges, returns or money refunds once the merchandise has been delivered. Before confirming your order via WhatsApp we help you resolve any questions about sizes, measurements, materials and operation so you can buy with total confidence.

menores.s1_x: NOPTABÚ does not sell products to anyone under 18 years of age under any circumstances. By placing an order you declare that you are of legal age, and we reserve the right to request an identity document proving it before completing the delivery. Any order identified as placed by a minor will be cancelled immediately.
